source_document: Master Direction - Know Your Customer (KYC) Direction, 2016
scope: KYC / AML / CFT compliance requirements relevant to the uploaded RBI KYC Direction

requirements.requirement: Maintain a KYC policy duly approved by the Board of Directors or an authorized Board committee.
assessment_questions: Is the KYC policy formally approved by the Board or authorized committee?

requirements.requirement: The KYC policy shall include Customer Acceptance Policy, Risk Management, Customer Identification Procedures (CIP), and Monitoring of Transactions.
assessment_questions: Does the KYC policy contain all four required key elements?

requirements.requirement: Periodically identify, assess and mitigate money laundering and terrorist financing risks across customers, countries/geographies, products, services, transactions and delivery channels.
assessment_questions: Is a documented ML/TF risk assessment performed periodically?
Does it cover relevant customer, geographic, product, transaction and channel risks?

requirements.requirement: Apply a risk-based approach with Board-approved policies, controls and procedures and implement a CDD programme proportionate to ML/TF risk and business size.
assessment_questions: Are customer and transaction risks used to determine the level of KYC/CDD controls?

requirements.requirement: Nominate a Designated Director responsible for overall compliance with applicable PML Act and Rules obligations and communicate the required details to FIU-IND and RBI.
assessment_questions: Is a Designated Director formally nominated and are required details communicated?

requirements.requirement: Appoint a Principal Officer responsible for compliance, transaction monitoring and required information sharing/reporting, with required details communicated to FIU-IND and RBI.
assessment_questions: Is a Principal Officer assigned with documented KYC/AML responsibilities?

requirements.requirement: Define senior-management responsibility, allocate implementation responsibilities, independently evaluate compliance, conduct internal/concurrent audits and submit quarterly audit notes to the Audit Committee.
assessment_questions: Are KYC compliance responsibilities and independent audit/evaluation mechanisms documented?

requirements.requirement: Maintain a Customer Acceptance Policy and do not open anonymous, fictitious or benami accounts or establish relationships without required CDD.
assessment_questions: Does onboarding prevent anonymous/fictitious/benami accounts?
Is CDD completed before establishing the relationship?

requirements.requirement: Specify mandatory KYC information required at account opening and during periodic KYC updation; obtain additional information with explicit customer consent where applicable.
assessment_questions: Are mandatory KYC fields defined?
Is explicit consent captured when additional information is requested?

requirements.requirement: Maintain a suitable system to ensure customer identity does not match applicable sanctions lists specified under the Direction.
assessment_questions: Is customer screening performed against applicable sanctions lists?

requirements.requirement: Perform customer identification at account-based onboarding and specified transaction, authenticity-doubt and structured-transaction scenarios.
assessment_questions: Does the CIP process trigger in all applicable cases?

requirements.requirement: Where reliance on third-party CDD is permitted, obtain CDD records promptly, ensure the third party is appropriately regulated and not based in a high-risk jurisdiction, while retaining ultimate CDD responsibility.
assessment_questions: If third-party CDD is used, are the required conditions satisfied and documented?

requirements.requirement: Obtain and verify prescribed identity/address information and other required information for individuals, beneficial owners, authorized signatories and power-of-attorney holders.
assessment_questions: Are prescribed identity and address documents obtained and verified for applicable individuals?

requirements.regulation: Chapter VI, Paragraph 16 and Annex I
requirements.requirement: Where applicable, perform Aadhaar authentication/offline verification or Digital KYC in accordance with the Direction and applicable law; redact Aadhaar where authentication is not required.
assessment_questions: Are Aadhaar-related KYC processes performed only through permitted methods?

requirements.requirement: Apply enhanced due diligence measures to eligible non-face-to-face onboarding, including required address, PAN, transaction and monitoring controls.
assessment_questions: Are enhanced due diligence controls applied to applicable non-face-to-face customers?

requirements.requirement: Where V-CIP is used, maintain prescribed secure infrastructure, workflow, trained officials, encryption, auditability, liveness/spoof detection and testing controls.
assessment_questions: Does the V-CIP implementation satisfy the prescribed security, audit and verification requirements?

requirements.requirement: For cloud-based V-CIP, ensure ownership of data remains with the RE and required data/video is transferred to RE-controlled infrastructure without retention by the cloud or assisting third-party provider.
assessment_questions: Does the V-CIP cloud arrangement prevent unauthorized third-party retention of required V-CIP data?

requirements.regulation: Chapter I definitions and Chapter VI
requirements.requirement: Identify and verify beneficial owners according to the applicable customer/entity type and prescribed ownership or control criteria.
assessment_questions: Are beneficial owners identified and verified for applicable legal entities and arrangements?

requirements.requirement: Perform ongoing due diligence and monitor transactions so they remain consistent with the RE's knowledge of the customer, business, risk profile and source of funds/wealth.
assessment_questions: Are customer transactions monitored against customer profile and risk?

requirements.requirement: Align monitoring intensity with customer risk and periodically review customer risk categorisation; high-risk accounts require intensified monitoring.
assessment_questions: Are customer risk categories reviewed at least as required and does monitoring intensity reflect risk?

requirements.requirement: Keep CDD information current using a risk-based periodic KYC updation process, with prescribed minimum periodicity for high-, medium- and low-risk customers.
assessment_questions: Is KYC periodically updated according to customer risk category?

requirements.requirement: Use the KYC Identifier and retrieve/update KYC records through CKYCR as required, including handling of updated customer information.
assessment_questions: Does the RE use CKYCR/KYC Identifier processes as required?

requirements.requirement: Maintain transaction records for at least five years from the date of transaction and customer identification/address records for at least five years after the business relationship ends.
assessment_questions: Are required KYC and transaction records retained for the prescribed periods?

requirements.requirement: Maintain transaction information sufficient to reconstruct individual transactions, including nature, amount/currency, date and parties.
assessment_questions: Can individual transactions be reconstructed from retained records?

requirements.requirement: Maintain records so identification and transaction data can be made available swiftly to competent authorities upon request.
assessment_questions: Can required KYC and transaction records be retrieved promptly for competent authorities?

requirements.requirement: Furnish information required under the PML (Maintenance of Records) Rules to FIU-IND using prescribed reporting requirements and formats.
assessment_questions: Are applicable reports furnished to FIU-IND using prescribed processes?

requirements.requirement: Maintain suitable technological capability for extracting and reporting CTR/STR data and use robust software that generates alerts when transactions are inconsistent with customer risk categorisation and profile.
assessment_questions: Does the AML system generate alerts for transactions inconsistent with customer risk/profile?
Can CTR/STR data be extracted and reported?

requirements.requirement: Maintain confidentiality regarding records and information furnished to FIU-IND, subject to permitted information sharing.
assessment_questions: Is access to FIU reporting information restricted and confidential?

requirements.requirement: For PEP relationships, apply prescribed risk management, source of funds/wealth checks, senior management approval and ongoing enhanced monitoring.
assessment_questions: Are applicable PEP relationships subject to enhanced due diligence and senior management approval?

requirements.requirement: Appropriate AI and ML technologies may be used to support effective ongoing due diligence and monitoring.
assessment_questions: If AI/ML is used for KYC monitoring, is it integrated into an effective documented monitoring process?
